note: Renders 'in his baldness or in his forehead' as 'in the back of the garment or its front'—wrong idea, omits baldness/forehead.
Adds clause 'and its blood is bound to its life' not in the source
Source singular 'he called them by name' rendered as plural 'they called' (person change).
Omits the verb 'find' (יִמְצְאוּ) from 'will they not find and divide the prey'.
Adds 'about you' (عنكما): the people's words are made to be about the sons, not the sons' own evil words.
Reverses 'he did evil' (יַרְשִׁיעַ) to 'he was victorious'; also 'to whom he turned' becomes 'to every direction'
Adds 'my two daughters' where source says only 'with two'.
Renders 'what he says' as 'what happens', changing the idea.
Hebrew is a statement ('I will take... and give'), Arabic turns it into a rhetorical question ('Shall I take...?').
Second speaker rendered 'he said to him' instead of 'I said to him' (person reversed).
Adds 'decisive word' (كلمة حاسمة) not in source; changes 'became a sin' to 'was a decisive word in the sin'.
Adds 'I hear' (إني أسمع) as a predicate not present in the source's verbless clause.
Turns the statement 'You said: only the word of my lips...' into a rhetorical question ('Do you think mere words suffice...'), changing speaker/person and statement to question.
Adds 'the word of the LORD' as object of inquiry, not in source
Renders 'dishonor of the king' as 'harm that befalls the king,' adding harm and omitting dishonor.
Adds 'with him,' which is not in the source.
Omits the clause 'he said to them' (וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם) introducing the speech.
Adds a duplicated clause: 'we will let go the seventh year' is repeated twice.
Changes imperative 'cease' to third-person 'let him cease' and renders 'take comfort' as 'endure/be patient'.
Adds 'and perishes' (ويفنى) not present in the source's single verb 'expires'.
Renders 'you shall treat me as a stranger' as 'be arrogant against me', changing the idea.
Passive 'why is he pursued' changed to active 'how do we pursue him' (different subject/voice).
Arabic reverses 'our substance is not cut down' into 'Has He not destroyed our remnant?'
Adds 'the island' (الجزيرة) not in source; source means 'one not innocent'.
Renders 'right hand' as 'south' (الجنوب), changing the source's left/right contrast.
Arabic says 'paths of my destruction' instead of 'their destruction' (אידם), changing the possessor.
Adds 'my dust' (ترابي), which is not in the source; only the furrows weep.
Adds 'by his effort' and changes 'his delight with God' to 'being pleased with God.'
'rain of his might' (עֻזּוֹ) rendered as 'rain of the flood'; the idea 'his might' is changed/omitted.
Source says 'his mouth' (singular); Arabic has 'their mouth' (plural).
Source says 'You said' (2nd person); Arabic reads 'I said' (قُلْتُ), reversing the speaker.
Agent/object reversed: Hebrew 'they made him stumble', Arabic 'their tongue made them fall'.
Omits 'ten' — 'instrument of ten strings' rendered only as 'stringed instrument'.
Adds 'from the east' (مِنَ الشَّرْقِ), a distinct idea not in the source's 'aforetime'.
Indicative 'surely you will slay' rendered as optative wish 'I wish you would kill' (ليتك تقتل)
Adds 'you do not know' to the first clause and renders 'ponder' as 'incline'.
Hebrew 'calamity (הַוַּת) of the wicked' is rendered 'desire/lust of the wicked' — a different idea
Reverses subject/object: source says the wicked's mouth covers violence; Arabic says violence covers it
Source says 'you will add more'; Arabic says 'he/it will increase the matter,' shifting person and adding 'the matter'.
'Not wise' is rendered 'does not judge,' a different predicate.
First clause reversed: Arabic says 'deceit is a favor' instead of 'favor is false/deceitful'.
First clause says 'the crooked cannot straighten' instead of 'the crooked cannot be made straight' (active vs passive).
Imperative 'keep the king's command' turned into first-person 'I keep'; the introductory 'I say' is lost.
Second clause 'she who bore you' is rendered as 'conceived you,' losing the birth idea.
Passive 'the people are oppressed' rendered as active 'the people dominate/tyrannize', reversing agent and meaning.
Adds 'from their thrones' and renders 'inhabitants' as 'the mighty'; extra idea not in source.
Changes 2nd person 'you contended with her' to 3rd person 'he contends with her'; also 'restrained' rendered 'blows'.
'the abundance of your foreigners' rendered as 'the multitude of your enemies' — distinct idea changed.
Hebrew 'delight yourselves' rendered as 'mock', adding an idea not in the source
Adds 'all/every' to 'the place' (من كل الموضع), not in source.
Adds 'thoughts' (الأفكار) as subject of 'shall not perish from the priest,' not in source.
Omits the clause 'says Yahweh' (ne'um Yahweh) after 'I am proclaiming liberty for you'.
Divine title garbled: 'Yahweh of armies, God of Israel' rendered as 'the Lord, army of God, Israel'; 'God of Israel' title not clear.
Adds 'hunters with it' and does not clearly render 'bending the bow' for Ludim.
'Destruction from the north' is rendered as 'a disc/bite from the north'; the idea of destruction is missing.
Adds 'in the east' (في الشرق); source means 'as of old/former times' only.
Adds 'if a son or daughter is found in her' (وُجِدَ فِيهَا) not in source; source says they shall not deliver son or daughter.
Turns 'he has broken the covenant; will he escape?' into 'will he escape from breaking the covenant?'—loses the statement of breaking.
Adds 'two portions' (نصيبان) where source says simply 'portions' (חבלים).
Omission: 'not knowing ... the voices of the prophets' — Arabic says they did not know 'this' only, then makes the prophets' voices the thing fulfilled.
Adds 'the harm resulting from' insults, an idea not in the source.
Omits the closing subscription about being written from Laodicea.
Parenthetical 'فريضة القديسين' (ordinance of the saints) adds an idea not in the source; 'of the holy ones' is altered.
